description: DRI seized 2,988.21 kg of heroin at Mundra Port in two containers declared as semi-processed talc stones.
Case transferred to NIA; public reporting states NIA registered the case following a Ministry of Home Affairs order.
NIA conducted searches at multiple locations connected with the import of semi-processed talc stones and alleged contraband.
NIA search at Neb Sarai reportedly recovered white-powder material suspected to be talc mixed with narcotics.
NIA arrested Afghan national Sobhan Aryanfar in connection with the case.
First NIA charge-sheet filed against accused persons; later supplementary charge-sheets followed.
NIA announced a supplementary charge-sheet against nine narcotics traffickers.
A later supplementary charge-sheet formally named Harpreet Singh Talwar as Accused No. 24, according to the Supreme Court judgment.
Supreme Court declined regular bail to Harpreet Singh Talwar at that stage; judgment summarized prosecution material and the prima facie case considered by the Court.
A later Gujarat High Court judgment continued to discuss the case history and reproduced the prosecution theory concerning the 2,988.21 kg seizure and network.
